faqs.q: What is the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male is a male flare connector with a tube end and a 37° JIC male thread, in 316L stainless steel, forged. Its tube end uses a nut with a single ferrule that grips and seals on the outside of the tube. It is listed in 1/8" to 1" tube, in 10 part numbers.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers of the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male, such as IH-TF-UA-2-2-SF?
faqs.a: The number after the form code gives the size: IH-TF-UA-2-2-SF is 1/8" tube × 1/8" JIC 37° (5/16-24) and IH-TF-UA-16-16-SF is 1" tube × 1" JIC 37° (1-5/16-12). Quote the part number from the size table, or send the tube and thread sizes and the material, and we confirm the part number.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers does the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male cover?
faqs.a: The 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male is listed in 10 part numbers covering 1/8" to 1" tube. Tube end: 1/8" tube to 1" tube. Other end: 1/8" JIC 37° (5/16-24) to 1" JIC 37° (1-5/16-12).

faqs.q: How do I choose the size of the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male?
faqs.a: Choose the tube outside diameter first, then the 37° JIC size, because each part number pairs one tube size with one 37° JIC size, for example IH-TF-UA-2-2-SF. Check the thread type of the port before you order, because the wrong type will not seal.

faqs.q: What working pressure can the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male take?
faqs.a: A tube fitting is rated to the tube it is made up on, so the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male takes the pressure of the tube you fit. The manufacturer publishes working pressures for 316 stainless tubing from 2,000 psi on 7/8 inch tube up to 12,000 psi on 1/16 inch tube, depending on outside diameter and wall.

faqs.q: What is the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male made from?
faqs.a: The 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male is 316L stainless steel, forged, with bar stock to ASTM A479 and ASTM A276. 316L stainless steel resists corrosion in marine, chemical and process atmospheres far better than carbon steel, so it suits instrument and sampling lines on coastal sites.

faqs.q: Which standards does the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male follow?
faqs.a: The 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male follows these thread standards: 37° JIC to SAE J514 / ISO 8434-2. The tube end is a single ferrule compression joint, and the pressure rating comes from the tube.

faqs.a: The tube end of the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male takes tube of the listed outside diameter, held by the nut and single ferrule. The other end is 37° flare, a metal-to-metal seat on a 74° included cone. See the [316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Male Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Male](/p/316-stainless-single-ferrule-bulkhead-male-flare-connector-tube-x-37-jic-male) for the matching part.
